{{Quote|Foresee the future. The days of the Jedi are numbered. The legions of Bpfasshi grows. You cannot defeat us all.|Bpfasshi Dark Jedi|<ref name="HOD" />}}
A''' [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]]''' was part of a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].

==Biography==
[[File:DuelOnCommerceGuildTradingStation-Tales16.jpg|left|The duel, in which he died.|thumb]]
[[Gender/Legends|He]] was pursued by a cadre of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] in [[700 BBY]]. [[Jedi Order/Legends|The Jedi]] tracked the individual to a [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Commerce Guild trading station|station]], where the [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] was then cornered by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]]. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] taunted Minch about his size, as a consequence, Minch angrily fought the Bpfasshi. The [[Time/Legends|young]] Jedi was [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|bested]] by his opponent only to be saved by four other Jedi, who arrived just in time. Thus, the Dark Jedi [[Death/Legends|killed]] himself with his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] rather than reveal the location of his [[Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader|Master]], causing Minch consternation at his inability to defeat his opponent alone.<ref name="HOD" />
